description: React component for sharing and configuring a chatbot, including UI for editing chatbot settings, color customization, and sharing links.

methods.name: formatObj
methods.description: Constructs the chatbot configuration object based on current state values.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current chatbot configuration via API and updates state.

methods.name: onSwitchChange
methods.description: Updates the public/private status of the chatbot via API.

methods.name: handleCloseCopyPopOver
methods.description: Closes the copy link confirmation popover.

methods.name: onColorSelected
methods.description: Handles color selection and updates corresponding state.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Updates state for text fields based on user input.

methods.name: onBooleanChanged
methods.description: Updates boolean state fields based on user toggles.

methods.name: colorField
methods.description: Renders a color selection UI component.

methods.name: booleanField
methods.description: Renders a toggle switch UI component.

methods.name: textField
methods.description: Renders a text input UI component.
